meta.name: brief
meta.description: Clarify a new customer brief, desired outcome, constraints and evidence gaps. Use for kickoff or a first meeting; do not repeat discovery already supplied.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把新客户的需求问清楚,理出目标、限制条件与还缺的证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次新项目开工都要花很久才问清客户到底要什么。
copy.tagline_en: Pin down a new customer brief into clear goals, constraints, and evidence gaps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if kickoff meetings drag on before you understand what the client really wants.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 面对新客户需求时,会先弄清需求简述、期望结果、限制条件和证据缺口,再决定是否开始调查或行动。
howto.when: 在项目 kickoff 或首次客户会议时接手;若由 @fde 调用,则沿用其已脱敏的信息包和范围,不重做已有的 discovery。

say.text: 这是新客户的需求简述,帮我理清期望结果和限制条件
say.note: 它会先澄清,再判断是否动手

say.text: 这次 kickoff 有哪些证据缺口要补?
say.note: 它会列出缺口,并区分实现与验收

say.text: 别重复已经做过的 discovery,接着往下问
say.note: 沿用已有信息,不重新开始

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude starts a new customer brief by clarifying the desired outcome, constraints and evidence gaps before investigating or acting.
howto.when_en: Triggers at kickoff or a first meeting; when called by @fde it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting discovery.

say_en.text: Here's a new customer brief - help me pin down the outcome and constraints.
What evidence gaps should this kickoff close?
say_en.note: It lists gaps and separates acceptance from implementation.

say_en.text: Skip discovery already done - pick up where it left off.
